title: hieracium levicaule subsp. gudissiense
intro: Hieracium levicaule subsp. gudissiense, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a perennial plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include its ability to treat digestive issues, inflammation, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium levicaule subsp. gudissiense include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its wound-healing and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
